title: Works Well
text: Works Well. My daughter just moved into a new apartment that doesn't have a dishwasher. This drying rack is just what she needed! It works very well. It expands if you need it and it's easy to put it back into the original position when it's not being used. It can accommodate a lot of items. It's pretty sturdy. My daughter says it's great!

product_metadata.title: TOOLF Dish Drying Rack, Expandable Stainless Steel Dish Rack with Drainboard Set Kitchen Sink Organizer for Counter, Large Capacity Kitchen Accessories with 360° Swivel Spout
features: 【Multifunction & Large Capacity】The detachable cutlery box and cup holder can hold multiple cups, cutlery, forks, chopsticks and other cutlery. The two raised side bars prevent the lid, pan, and cutting board from falling off.

【Unique Expandable Design】The dish drying rack contains an extendable tray, which can be expanded and contracted according requirements. Closed 19.69*12.59*6.69 inches (50 x 32 x 17 cm). Extended 27.56*12.59*6.69 inches (70 x 32 x 17 cm)
【Innovative Drainage Design】Extendable 360° swivel spout, turn it to any direction. The design of drainboard set is conducive to water droplets to prevent gasification and keep it dry

【High Quality】The dish drainer is made of high-quality stainless steel and will not be deformed. Rust-proof and durable. The water channel and drip tray are made of PP environmental protection material
【Stable Kitchen Shelf】6 rubber feet prevent the dish drying rack from sliding on the table top, avoid scratching your sink or table top, and also protect your tableware
